extra.reason: Workspace scaffolded (core lib+spike bin, py cdylib+pyproject). cargo check --workspace passes and spike runs locally on macOS; cryptoki only dlopens at runtime so the build is Linux-equivalent. Resolved deps: reqwest 0.13 (rustls feature), rustls 0.23, cryptoki 0.12, pyo3 0.29.

Validated in-container (docker build OK, arm64). setup-test-token.sh provisions SoftHSM token 'testtok' with 2 EC identities (auth-cert/01, sign-cert/02), both private keys present with Usage:sign. mtls-test-server.sh: no-cert request rejected (TLS handshake, curl 56); auth-cert PEM -> HTTP 200. Harness ready for the spike (4wt) to hit.

open_identity(module,pin,label) in core::pkcs11 opens module, logs in (User PIN), finds cert+privkey by CKA_LABEL (errors unless exactly one). Spike verified in-container vs SoftHSM: auth-cert->CN=auth-cert, sign-cert->CN=sign-cert (distinct certs => label selection discriminates), missing label errors cleanly. cryptoki 0.12 API notes for uov: CInitializeArgs::new(CInitializeFlags::OS_LOCKING_OK); AuthPin::new(Box<str>) i.e. pin.into(); Session::find_objects does full init/find/final; get_attributes(h,&[AttributeType::Value])->Attribute::Value(der).

Spike complete; findings recorded on bead + PLAN.md. Approach validated (libcspid.so, standard PKCS#11). Remaining unknowns (RSA-PSS, key type, path, registration, agent/PIN) require the real module at the office.

Signer built (core::signer): Pkcs11SigningKey/Pkcs11Signer map rustls RSA_PSS_SHA256/384/512 -> cryptoki Mechanism::Sha*RsaPkcsPss, C_Sign on token; Pkcs11ClientCertResolver presents CertifiedKey from open_identity. RSA-PSS-only (EC dropped, YAGNI). PROVEN in-container: SoftHSM RSA auth-cert, TLS 1.3 handshake to openssl s_server returns HTTP 200 -> server validated our on-token RSA-PSS signature. Ported from rustls-pkcs11 (MIT, attributed).

core::client builds rustls ClientConfig (aws_lc_rs provider, default protocol versions incl TLS1.3) with the token-backed resolver + reqwest::blocking. Spike --url does mTLS GET. PROVEN: HTTP 200 (TLSv1.3, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384) from the SoftHSM-backed mTLS server using the token-held RSA key. Note: open_identity login made optional (Some(pin) for SoftHSM; None for CSPid cached agent).
